cohort: The study included 1221 pregnant women with confirmed intrauterine pregnancy, excluding those with pre-eclampsia in previous pregnancy or twin pregnancy.
finding: Serum leptin levels measured at 16 weeks gestation were similar in patients who developed pre-eclampsia and normotensive pregnant women.
mod_finding: The Cesarean rate was higher in the pre-eclampsia group (14.9%) compared to the normal pregnancy group (8.9%).
